entry.name: icon
entry.label: The name of the icon to use for the panel button.

entry.name: iconSize
entry.label: Size in pixels of the app icons in the grid.

entry.name: dimOpacity
entry.label: Opacity of the dark background dim behind the grid.

entry.name: showPageIndicator
entry.label: Show the page dots at the bottom of the grid.

entry.name: pagedMode
entry.label: Paginate the all-apps grid (swipe between pages) instead of one continuous vertically-scrolling list.

entry.name: lampAnimation
entry.label: Open and close with the magic lamp (Genie Anywhere KWin effect) instead of the icons flying out of the panel button.

entry.name: terminalCommand
entry.label: Terminal used for commands; the command line is appended after -e.
